market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76.3K must drop ~34% to touch $50K LOW by Dec 31, 2026. Plausible drawdown over 8 months given crypto volatility and macro uncertainty (Fed, geopolitics), but not base case. Market at 0.455 looks slightly too high relative to my estimate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of any future cycle correction.
